_comment: Scene for the air groups panel. Renderer keys: 'windows' with 'at' (where the engine puts each top-level window on a 2560x1440 screen; leave it out to use the file's own position until it is measured with render_gui.py --verify), 'rows' and 'listRows' (sample rows per list), 'height', 'hide' and 'place' (what the code sizes, hides or moves in this state); 'samples' (texts for named text boxes). Harness keys: 'setup' (recipe steps from the clean state; see wiki/Game-Recipes.md), 'captures' (extra named captures with their own steps), 'expect' (widgets that must be visible in the capture: proof that the recipe brought the screen up), 'crop' (x, y, width, height cut out of a capture). 'manual' and 'checklist' are what is left for a human.

windows.name: air_groups_view
windows._note: With a group selected the code puts the group badge and the whole wing list frame into this list (S35). 'at' assumes the list docks where the wing frame docks without a group (2,181); not measured.

airwing_selection_item.mission_state: On Mission in Western Mediterranean Sea

manual: A group of 13 to 15 wings: the compact wings stay single until 15 (wings_compact_number_of_elements 15)
The playset: RBM's 43 px army shields as the group insignia
checklist: Group badge 818x96: title strip with the insignia, the name, fuel, Select and the close button in the close column
Wings card: 'Air Wings' caption and the compact wings beside it
The wing frame under the badge is as wide as the badge and the header
Scroll the list to the end
_note: Creates an air group, whose badge appears above the airbase row and moves the wing list down in every later air capture of the same game; 'changesState' makes the harness run this scene last. 'at' of air_groups_view is not measured yet.
